```{r}
create_shortcut <- function(path, short_cut, drive) {
  return(
    sub(gsub("\\)", "\\\\)", gsub("\\(", "\\\\(", short_cut)), paste0(drive, ":"), path)
  )
}

if (nchar(dir_data) > 80) {
  system("subst x: /D")
  short_cut <- dir_home |> dirname()
  system(paste0("subst x: \"", short_cut, "\""))

  dir_objects_names <- ls(pattern = "^dir_")
  dir_list <- mget(dir_objects_names)

  dir_list_shortened <- lapply(
    dir_list,
    function(y) create_shortcut(y, short_cut, "x")
  )
  list2env(dir_list_shortened, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

rm(list = intersect(
  c("dir_objects_names", "short_cut", "dir_list", "dir_list_shortened"),
  ls()
))
```

## Modeling helpers

```{r modeling-helpers}
non_grey_me_names <- function(df) {
  grep("^ME", names(df), value = TRUE) %>%
    setdiff("MEgrey")
}

fit_module_pfas <- function(data, me_name, pfas_name, covars) {
  model_df <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(tidyselect::all_of(c(me_name, pfas_name, covars))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

  module_mean <- mean(model_df[[me_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  module_sd <- stats::sd(model_df[[me_name]], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (nrow(model_df) <= length(covars) + 2 || is.na(module_sd) || module_sd == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
      pfas = pfas_name,
      n = nrow(model_df),
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std.error = NA_real_,
      conf.low = NA_real_,
      conf.high = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      module_mean = module_mean,
      module_sd = module_sd,
      outcome_scale = "module_eigengene_SD"
    ))
  }

  model_df <- model_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(module_eigengene_z = (.data[[me_name]] - module_mean) / module_sd)

  tryCatch(
    {
      fit <- stats::lm(stats::reformulate(c(pfas_name, covars), response = "module_eigengene_z"), data = model_df)

      broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::filter(term == pfas_name) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
          pfas = pfas_name,
          n = nrow(model_df),
          estimate,
          std.error,
          conf.low,
          conf.high,
          p.value,
          module_mean = module_mean,
          module_sd = module_sd,
          outcome_scale = "module_eigengene_SD"
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(
        module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
        pfas = pfas_name,
        n = nrow(model_df),
        estimate = NA_real_,
        std.error = NA_real_,
        conf.low = NA_real_,
        conf.high = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        module_mean = module_mean,
        module_sd = module_sd,
        outcome_scale = "module_eigengene_SD"
      )
    }
  )
}

run_module_pfas_models <- function(data,
                                   me_names,
                                   pfas_names,
                                   pfas_abbrev_names,
                                   covars,
                                   cohort,
                                   module_set) {
  purrr::map_dfr(
    pfas_names,
    function(pfas_name) {
      purrr::map_dfr(
        me_names,
        ~ fit_module_pfas(data, .x, pfas_name, covars)
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          pfas_abbrev = pfas_abbrev_names[match(pfas_name, pfas_names)]
        )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = cohort,
      module_set = module_set,
      p.adjust.BH = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      p.adjust.BY = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BY")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(cohort, module_set, module, pfas, pfas_abbrev, n)
}
```

# PFAS Mixture Models

## qgcomp helpers

```{r qgcomp-helpers}
fit_module_qgcomp <- function(data, me_name, pfas_names, covars, q = 4, B = 500) {
  model_df <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(tidyselect::all_of(c(me_name, pfas_names, covars))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

  module_mean <- mean(model_df[[me_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  module_sd <- stats::sd(model_df[[me_name]], na.rm = TRUE)

  empty_result <- tibble::tibble(
    module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
    mixture = "PFAS mixture",
    n = nrow(model_df),
    estimate = NA_real_,
    std.error = NA_real_,
    conf.low = NA_real_,
    conf.high = NA_real_,
    p.value = NA_real_,
    q = q,
    B = B,
    exposure_scale = "original",
    module_mean = module_mean,
    module_sd = module_sd,
    outcome_scale = "module_eigengene_SD",
    error = NA_character_
  )

  empty_weights <- tibble::tibble(
    module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
    pfas_log2 = character(),
    pfas = character(),
    weight = numeric(),
    direction = character(),
    q = integer(),
    B = integer(),
    exposure_scale = character()
  )

  if (nrow(model_df) <= length(c(pfas_names, covars)) + 2 || is.na(module_sd) || module_sd == 0) {
    return(list(result = empty_result, weights = empty_weights))
  }

  model_df <- model_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(module_eigengene_z = (.data[[me_name]] - module_mean) / module_sd)

  tryCatch(
    {
      pfas_original_names <- paste0("qgcomp_original_", seq_along(pfas_names))

      for (i in seq_along(pfas_names)) {
        model_df[[pfas_original_names[i]]] <- 2^model_df[[pfas_names[i]]]
      }

      fit <- qgcomp::qgcomp.boot(
        f = stats::reformulate(c(pfas_original_names, covars), response = "module_eigengene_z"),
        expnms = pfas_original_names,
        data = model_df,
        q = q,
        B = B,
        family = gaussian()
      )

      psi <- as.numeric(fit$psi)
      se <- sqrt(as.numeric(fit$var.psi))

      result <- tibble::tibble(
        module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
        mixture = "PFAS mixture",
        n = nrow(model_df),
        estimate = psi,
        std.error = se,
        conf.low = psi - 1.96 * se,
        conf.high = psi + 1.96 * se,
        p.value = 2 * stats::pnorm(abs(psi / se), lower.tail = FALSE),
        q = q,
        B = B,
        exposure_scale = "original",
        module_mean = module_mean,
        module_sd = module_sd,
        outcome_scale = "module_eigengene_SD",
        error = NA_character_
      )

      if (!is.null(fit$pos.weights) || !is.null(fit$neg.weights)) {
        weights <- dplyr::bind_rows(
          tibble::tibble(
            module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
            pfas = names(fit$pos.weights),
            weight = as.numeric(fit$pos.weights),
            direction = "Positive",
            q = q,
            B = B,
            exposure_scale = "original"
          ),
          tibble::tibble(
            module = stringr::str_remove(me_name, "^ME"),
            pfas = names(fit$neg.weights),
            weight = as.numeric(fit$neg.weights),
            direction = "Negative",
            q = q,
            B = B,
            exposure_scale = "original"
          )
        ) %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(weight), weight > 0) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            pfas_log2 = pfas_names[match(pfas, pfas_original_names)]
          )
      } else {
        weights <- empty_weights
      }

      list(result = result, weights = weights)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      empty_result$error <- conditionMessage(e)
      list(result = empty_result, weights = empty_weights)
    }
  )
}

run_module_qgcomp_models <- function(data,
                                     me_names,
                                     pfas_names,
                                     pfas_abbrev_names,
                                     covars,
                                     cohort,
                                     module_set,
                                     q = 4,
                                     B = qgcomp_boot_B) {
  fits <- purrr::map(
    me_names,
    ~ fit_module_qgcomp(
      data = data,
      me_name = .x,
      pfas_names = pfas_names,
      covars = covars,
      q = q,
      B = B
    )
  )

  results <- purrr::map_dfr(fits, "result") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = cohort,
      module_set = module_set,
      p.adjust.BH = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      p.adjust.BY = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BY")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(cohort, module_set, module, mixture, n)

  weights <- purrr::map_dfr(fits, "weights") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = cohort,
      module_set = module_set,
      pfas_abbrev = pfas_abbrev_names[match(pfas_log2, pfas_names)]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(cohort, module_set, module, pfas_log2, pfas_abbrev, pfas)

  list(results = results, weights = weights)
}
```

# Heatmap

```{r solar-module-estimate-heatmap}
SOLAR_module_order <- SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$module_overview %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    module != "grey",
    module %in% stringr::str_remove(SOLAR_projected_me_names, "^ME")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_proteins), module) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module_label = paste0("M", dplyr::row_number()))

SOLAR_module_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  SOLAR_module_pfas_results %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      cohort,
      module_set,
      module,
      exposure = pfas_abbrev,
      exposure_type = "Individual PFAS",
      n,
      estimate,
      std.error,
      conf.low,
      conf.high,
      p.value,
      p.adjust.BH,
      outcome_scale
    ),
  SOLAR_module_qgcomp_results %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      cohort,
      module_set,
      module,
      exposure = mixture,
      exposure_type = "PFAS mixture",
      n,
      estimate,
      std.error,
      conf.low,
      conf.high,
      p.value,
      p.adjust.BH,
      outcome_scale
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(SOLAR_module_order, by = "module") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = cohort_names),
    module = factor(module, levels = SOLAR_module_order$module),
    module_label = factor(module_label, levels = SOLAR_module_order$module_label),
    exposure = factor(exposure, levels = rev(c(PFAS_abbrev_names, "PFAS mixture"))),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      p.adjust.BH < 0.2 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
```

# Circular Plots

```{r solar-reference-module-circular-network-inputs}
circular_max_nodes <- 20
circular_min_TOM <- 0.10
circular_TOM_threshold_quantile <- 0.90
circular_adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.20
circular_nominal_p_threshold <- 0.05
circular_reactome_n_pathways_to_show <- c(5, 10)
circular_reactome_broad_pathway_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    "^Metabolism$",
    "^Metabolism of proteins$",
    # "^Signal Transduction$",
    "^Immune System$",
    "^Disease$",
    "^Developmental Biology$",
    "^Gene expression \\(Transcription\\)$",
    # "^Transport of small molecules$",
    "^Cell Cycle$",
    "^Hemostasis$",
    # "^Programmed Cell Death$",
    # "^Cell-Cell communication$",
    "^Biological oxidations$",
    "^Dengue Virus Infection$",
    "^Dengue Virus-Host Interactions$"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

SOLAR_protein_labels <- proteomics_l$protein_annotation$SOLAR %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    protein = meta_id,
    protein_label = dplyr::coalesce(meta_Assay, meta_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(protein, .keep_all = TRUE)

selected_significant_modules <- SOLAR_module_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(module_label),
    module != "grey",
    p.adjust.BH < circular_adjusted_p_threshold | p.value < circular_nominal_p_threshold
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(module_label, module, n_proteins) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_label = as.character(module_label),
    module = as.character(module)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_label)

calculate_module_membership <- function(module_name) {
  module_proteins <- SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$wgcna$module_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(module == module_name) %>%
    dplyr::pull(protein)

  module_eigengene_name <- paste0("ME", module_name)
  module_eigengene <- SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$wgcna$MEs[[module_eigengene_name]]

  kME <- stats::cor(
    SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$wgcna$datExpr[, module_proteins, drop = FALSE],
    module_eigengene,
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )[, 1]

  tibble::tibble(
    protein = names(kME),
    module = module_name,
    kME = as.numeric(kME),
    kME_abs = abs(kME)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(SOLAR_protein_labels, by = "protein") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(protein_label = dplyr::coalesce(protein_label, protein))
}

get_reactome_pathways_for_proteins <- function(protein_df) {
  empty_protein_pathways <- protein_df %>%
    dplyr::select(protein, protein_label) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      entrez_id = NA_character_,
      pathway_id = NA_character_,
      pathway_name = NA_character_,
      is_broad_pathway = NA
    )

  if (!requireNamespace("ReactomePA", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(empty_protein_pathways)
  }

  entrez_map <- tryCatch(
    map_proteins_to_entrez(protein_df$protein_label, from_type = "SYMBOL") %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        protein_label = SYMBOL,
        entrez_id = as.character(ENTREZID)
      ),
    error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
  )

  if (nrow(entrez_map) == 0) {
    return(empty_protein_pathways)
  }

  protein_entrez_df <- protein_df %>%
    dplyr::select(protein, protein_label) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(entrez_map, by = "protein_label")

  input_genes <- protein_entrez_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(entrez_id), entrez_id != "") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(entrez_id) %>%
    dplyr::pull(entrez_id)

  if (length(input_genes) == 0) {
    return(empty_protein_pathways)
  }

  reactome_obj <- tryCatch(
    ReactomePA::enrichPathway(
      gene = input_genes,
      organism = "human",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      qvalueCutoff = 1,
      readable = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(reactome_obj)) {
    return(empty_protein_pathways)
  }

  reactome_df <- as.data.frame(reactome_obj)

  if (nrow(reactome_df) == 0) {
    return(empty_protein_pathways)
  }

  reactome_gene_pathways <- reactome_df %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      pathway_id = ID,
      pathway_name = Description,
      entrez_id = geneID
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(entrez_id, sep = "/") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_broad_pathway = stringr::str_detect(pathway_name, circular_reactome_broad_pathway_pattern)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(entrez_id, pathway_id, pathway_name, is_broad_pathway)

  protein_entrez_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(reactome_gene_pathways, by = "entrez_id")
}

select_reactome_pathways_to_keep <- function(pathway_assignments) {
  kept_pathways <- pathway_assignments %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pathway_name), !is_broad_pathway) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(protein, pathway_id, pathway_name) %>%
    dplyr::count(pathway_id, pathway_name, name = "n_selected_proteins") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_selected_proteins > 1) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_selected_proteins), pathway_name) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = circular_reactome_n_pathways_to_show[[2]])

  if (nrow(kept_pathways) < circular_reactome_n_pathways_to_show[[1]]) {
    kept_pathways <- pathway_assignments %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(pathway_name)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(protein, pathway_id, pathway_name) %>%
      dplyr::count(pathway_id, pathway_name, name = "n_selected_proteins") %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_selected_proteins > 1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_selected_proteins), pathway_name) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = circular_reactome_n_pathways_to_show[[2]])
  }

  kept_pathways
}

assign_reactome_pathways_to_proteins <- function(protein_df,
                                                 pathway_assignments,
                                                 kept_pathways) {
  if (nrow(pathway_assignments) == 0) {
    return(protein_df %>% dplyr::mutate(
      reactome_pathway_id = NA_character_,
      reactome_pathway = "Other/unique Reactome pathways"
    ))
  }

  if (all(is.na(pathway_assignments$pathway_name))) {
    return(protein_df %>% dplyr::mutate(
      reactome_pathway_id = NA_character_,
      reactome_pathway = "Other/unique Reactome pathways"
    ))
  }

  if (nrow(kept_pathways) == 0) {
    return(protein_df %>% dplyr::mutate(
      reactome_pathway_id = NA_character_,
      reactome_pathway = "Other/unique Reactome pathways"
    ))
  }

  selected_pathway_assignments <- pathway_assignments %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(kept_pathways, by = c("pathway_id", "pathway_name")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(protein) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_selected_proteins), pathway_name, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      reactome_pathway_id = pathway_id,
      reactome_pathway = pathway_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(protein, reactome_pathway_id, reactome_pathway)

  protein_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(selected_pathway_assignments, by = "protein") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      reactome_pathway = dplyr::case_when(
        protein %in% pathway_assignments$protein[!is.na(pathway_assignments$pathway_name)] &
          is.na(reactome_pathway) ~ "Other/unique Reactome pathways",
        TRUE ~ dplyr::coalesce(reactome_pathway, "Other/unique Reactome pathways")
      ),
      reactome_pathway_id = dplyr::if_else(
        reactome_pathway == "Other/unique Reactome pathways",
        NA_character_,
        reactome_pathway_id
      )
    )
}

finalize_reactome_pathway_assignments <- function(protein_df,
                                                  pathway_assignments,
                                                  kept_pathways) {
  current_kept_pathways <- kept_pathways

  repeat {
    pathway_assignments_final <- assign_reactome_pathways_to_proteins(
      protein_df,
      pathway_assignments,
      current_kept_pathways
    )

    final_pathway_counts <- pathway_assignments_final %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(reactome_pathway_id)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(protein, reactome_pathway_id, reactome_pathway) %>%
      dplyr::count(reactome_pathway_id, reactome_pathway, name = "n_selected_proteins")

    next_kept_pathways <- current_kept_pathways %>%
      dplyr::select(pathway_id, pathway_name) %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(
        final_pathway_counts,
        by = c("pathway_id" = "reactome_pathway_id", "pathway_name" = "reactome_pathway")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_selected_proteins > 1) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_selected_proteins), pathway_name)

    if (nrow(next_kept_pathways) == nrow(current_kept_pathways)) {
      return(list(
        pathways = pathway_assignments_final,
        pathways_to_keep = next_kept_pathways
      ))
    }

    if (nrow(next_kept_pathways) == 0) {
      return(list(
        pathways = assign_reactome_pathways_to_proteins(
          protein_df,
          pathway_assignments,
          next_kept_pathways
        ),
        pathways_to_keep = next_kept_pathways
      ))
    }

    current_kept_pathways <- next_kept_pathways
  }
}

build_module_network <- function(module_name,
                                 n_proteins,
                                 min_TOM = circular_min_TOM) {
  node_df <- calculate_module_membership(module_name) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(kME_abs, n = circular_max_nodes, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(kME_abs))

  if (nrow(node_df) < 2) {
    stop("At least two proteins are required to build a module network.")
  }

  top_proteins <- node_df$protein
  top_expr <- SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$wgcna$datExpr[, top_proteins, drop = FALSE]

  tom_matrix <- WGCNA::TOMsimilarityFromExpr(
    top_expr,
    power = SOLAR_WGCNA_model$reference$wgcna$soft_power,
    networkType = SOLAR_WGCNA_model$parameters$network_type,
    TOMType = SOLAR_WGCNA_model$parameters$tom_type,
    verbose = 0
  )
  dimnames(tom_matrix) <- list(top_proteins, top_proteins)

  edge_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(tom_matrix), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::rename(from = Var1, to = Var2, TOM = Freq) %>%
    dplyr::filter(from < to)

  TOM_threshold <- max(
    min_TOM,
    stats::quantile(
      edge_df$TOM,
      probs = circular_TOM_threshold_quantile,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  edge_df <- edge_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(TOM >= TOM_threshold)

  connected_proteins <- unique(c(edge_df$from, edge_df$to))

  node_df <- node_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(protein %in% connected_proteins) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      kME_group = dplyr::ntile(kME_abs, 3),
      kME_group = factor(
        kME_group,
        levels = c(1, 2, 3),
        labels = c("Relatively\nperipheral", "Moderately\ncentral", "Highly\ncentral")
      )
    )

  edge_df <- edge_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(from %in% node_df$protein, to %in% node_df$protein)

  module_graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = edge_df,
    vertices = node_df %>% dplyr::rename(name = protein),
    directed = FALSE
  )

  igraph::set_graph_attr(module_graph, "TOM_threshold", TOM_threshold)
}

selected_significant_modules %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "SOLAR reference modules selected for circular network plots: BH-adjusted p < 0.20 or nominal p < 0.05.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r solar-reference-module-circular-network-plots, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
circular_network_reactome_pathways_to_keep <- circular_network_reactome_assignment$pathways_to_keep

circular_network_reactome_pathways <- circular_network_reactome_assignment$pathways %>%

circular_network_reactome_pathways_to_keep <- circular_network_reactome_pathways %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(reactome_pathway_id)) %>%

circular_network_reactome_pathways <- circular_network_reactome_pathways %>%

circular_network_pathway_colors["Other/unique Reactome pathways"] <- "grey80"

add_reactome_pathways_to_graph <- function(module_graph) {
  node_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(module_graph, what = "vertices") %>%
    dplyr::rename(protein = name) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      circular_network_reactome_pathways %>%
        dplyr::select(protein, reactome_pathway_id, reactome_pathway),
      by = "protein"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(reactome_pathway = dplyr::coalesce(
      as.character(reactome_pathway),
      "Other/unique Reactome pathways"
    ))

  edge_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(module_graph, what = "edges")

  graph_with_reactome <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = edge_df,
    vertices = node_df %>% dplyr::rename(name = protein),
    directed = FALSE
  )

  igraph::set_graph_attr(
    graph_with_reactome,
    "TOM_threshold",
    igraph::graph_attr(module_graph, "TOM_threshold")
  )
}

plot_module_circular_network <- function(module_name,
                                         module_label,
                                         n_proteins,
                                         module_graph = NULL,
                                         show_pathway_legend = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(module_graph)) {
    module_graph <- build_module_network(module_name, n_proteins = n_proteins)
  }

  module_graph <- add_reactome_pathways_to_graph(module_graph)
  circular_layout <- ggraph::create_layout(module_graph, layout = "linear", circular = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_x = x * 1.12,
      label_y = y * 1.12,
      label_hjust = dplyr::case_when(
        x > 0.15 ~ 0,
        x < -0.15 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0.5
      )
    )

  ggraph::ggraph(circular_layout) +
    ggraph::geom_edge_arc(
      ggplot2::aes(
        alpha = TOM,
        color = TOM,
        edge_width = TOM
      ),
      width = 0.4,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    ggraph::geom_node_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = kME_group, color = reactome_pathway),
      alpha = 0.9,
      show.legend = c(size = TRUE, colour = show_pathway_legend)
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = circular_layout,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = label_x,
        y = label_y,
        label = protein_label,
        hjust = label_hjust
      ),
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fill = ggplot2::alpha("white", 0.65),
      linewidth = 0,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.06, "lines")
    ) +
    ggraph::scale_edge_alpha(
      range = c(0.20, 0.85),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    ggraph::scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.15, 0.7),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    ggraph::scale_edge_color_gradient(
      low = "grey70",
      high = "#54278F",
      name = "Network similarity",
      guide = ggraph::guide_edge_colourbar(
        direction = "vertical",
        title.position = "top",
        order = 2,
        barwidth = grid::unit(0.12, "in"),
        barheight = grid::unit(0.8, "in")
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_manual(
      values = c(
        "Relatively\nperipheral" = 2,
        "Moderately\ncentral" = 3.5,
        "Highly\ncentral" = 6
      ),
      name = "Module membership",
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = circular_network_pathway_colors,
      name = "Reactome pathway",
      na.value = "grey60",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal(clip = "off") +
    # title = paste0(module_label, " top ", circular_max_nodes, " hub proteins")
    # subtitle = paste0(
    #   "TOM >= ", round(igraph::graph_attr(module_graph, "TOM_threshold"), 3),
    #   "; isolated hubs after TOM filtering removed"
    # )
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 1, r = 4, b = 1, l = 6)
    )
}

SOLAR_module_circular_network_plots <- purrr::pmap(
  dplyr::bind_cols(
    selected_significant_modules,
    tibble::tibble(module_graph = SOLAR_module_circular_network_graphs)
  ),
  function(module_label, module, n_proteins, module_graph) {
    plot_module_circular_network(
      module,
      module_label,
      n_proteins,
      module_graph = module_graph,
      show_pathway_legend = FALSE
    )
  }
)

SOLAR_module_circular_network_legend_plots <- purrr::map(

SOLAR_module_circular_network_legends <- purrr::map(
  SOLAR_module_circular_network_legend_plots,
  cowplot::get_legend
)

SOLAR_module_circular_network_panel_plots <- purrr::map(
  SOLAR_module_circular_network_plots,
  ~ .x + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
)

SOLAR_module_circular_network_panel_with_legends <- purrr::map2(
  SOLAR_module_circular_network_panel_plots,
  SOLAR_module_circular_network_legends,
  ~ cowplot::plot_grid(
    .x,
    NULL,
    .y,
    NULL,
    ncol = 4,
    rel_widths = c(1, 0.01, 0.32, 0.03)
  )
)

SOLAR_module_circular_network_pathway_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  tibble::tibble(
    reactome_pathway = factor(
      circular_network_pathway_levels,
      levels = circular_network_pathway_levels
    ),
    x = seq_along(circular_network_pathway_levels),
    y = 1
  ) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, color = reactome_pathway)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = circular_network_pathway_colors,
      name = "Reactome pathway",
      na.value = "grey60",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        nrow = 4,
        byrow = TRUE,
        title.position = "top",
        override.aes = list(size = 3)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      legend.title.position = "top",
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(8, "pt"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(10, "pt"),
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
    )
)

SOLAR_module_circular_network_figure <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = SOLAR_module_circular_network_panel_with_legends,
    ncol = 2,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr"
  ),
  SOLAR_module_circular_network_pathway_legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.18)
)

SOLAR_module_circular_network_figure
```
